messages:
emily: cc @here quick PR up — adds a minimal airgapped proxy example for Private/VPC installs (KMS + HSM). Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/pr/4852 :wave:

raj: i'll review. is this addressing nftables+haproxy flow? we should list expected ports (eg 443, 1025-65535 for ephemeral, 2600 for HSM?)

emily: good q — current draft includes a short port matrix but not the ephemeral range. adding.

steph: security note: for PKCS#11 sockets the HSM user needs chown to root:kmssvc and 0700 perms — add a short warning. also call out HSM vendor-specific pin doc link.

jorge: adding a tiny SDK snippet (python) for the proxy env + direct KMS call, plz include in examples section:

```python
import os
import requests
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://10.0.0.5:3128'
resp = requests.post('https://kms.local.internal/v1/sign', json={'data':'...'}, timeout=5)
print(resp.status_code)
```

linda: docs-lint flagged a broken link: the KMS cert-chain example link is 404. replace /k... with /private/kms/cert-chain (I can push fix).

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #4852 — 3 warnings (link-check, code-style)

raj: can you paste the nftables snippet you're adding? i want to ensure we don't open ephemeral wide for sealed sites.

emily: snippet below — intended minimal NAT for proxy-only egress:

```bash
# allow proxy outbound
nft add table ip redwood
nft add chain ip redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
nft add rule ip redwood forward ct state established,related accept
nft add rule ip redwood forward ip saddr 10.0.0.0/16 tcp dport { 80, 443 } accept
nft add rule ip redwood forward ip daddr 10.0.0.5 tcp dport 3128 accept
```

steph: prefer adding comment to not suggest opening all ephemeral ports. maybe suggest using conntrack helper + restrict to internal proxies.

emily: agreed — i'll update. tagging raj as reviewer; @raj please review the HSM pkcs11 snippet + nft rules. once approved i'll squash and update PR description with link fix.

raj: looks good, will review this afternoon. :eyes:

emily: perfect — thanks all. aiming to merge EOW. :thumbsup:
